page.layout: One centred title block on a single page; below it a gathering signature at the foot. No running head, page number or notes.
page.notes: The signature "M 2" is set in a stylised form; the final character may be "ij" and is marked [?]. The first lines of the title are set in italic capitals, and the reading of "DA-" / "TUM" is a hyphenated split of DATUM. The engraving-free title page carries no other printed matter.
